name: Donut Dongle gameID v0.7.14
body:
**Mobile Client**
- Remote OSD now has button navigation overlay
- WebCtl is now cellphone friendly

**Setup**
- Hostname is now customizable during initial setup. ONLY "a-z", "0-9", and "-" (hyphen) characters are allowed. (edge hyphens not allowed)

**UX**
- progress bar is now cumulative for all bulk file operations
